title: Ticket precedence
prompt:
Ticket routing: if account security is involved, send security; otherwise charges to billing; otherwise bugs to technical. Message: "Someone stole my login and made a purchase." Return team. Return only valid JSON with exactly these fields: team. Numeric values must be JSON numbers; boolean values must be JSON booleans; absent values null. No extra fields.

Write that JSON, and nothing else, to answer.json in the current directory.
acceptance: answer.json equals the gold answer under Abdul's equality rule
